info.prompt: The player's perspective shifts to a cinematic sweep across a bio-digital cathedral, its ribcage-like supports humming with latent energy. Five token slots ignite one by one along a skeletal gold interface, their crimson glow casting long shadows across the Void Black backdrop. Fractured neon text flickers diagnostic data across the lower third while synaptic connections snap between pulsing ability-gated tiles. Suddenly, the fifth Perfect hit triggers a cascading particle storm—Electric Magenta and gold filigree exploding outward in perfect sync with the bass drop.
